ValidationRule.description: If the recorded Payee Name does not match the linked Account name, a signed NOC must be confirmed (AF_NOCRecorded__c) before the payment can be saved.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISBLANK(AF_PayeeName__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(AF_Account__c)), AF_PayeeName__c <> AF_Account__r.Name, NOT(AF_NOCRecorded__c) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Payee Name does not match the customer name on the linked Account. Confirm a signed NOC is on file (check "NOC Recorded?") before saving.
